body:
New project `research/collision-elicitation` (stdlib Python, MIT, 8 tests, whitepaper, experiments), building on multi-observation elicitation (Frongillo, Waggoner et al.) applied to nondeterministic/replicated ML execution.

- Two-run squared-error score is proper for the collision probability, with exact regret; one run provably cannot elicit it.
- Exact all-pairs U-statistic variance (about a quarter of disjoint pairs at n=100).
- Fleet of H hardware classes: strict-equality false-slash rate 1−H^(1−k).
- Collusion blind spot at ε=2Γ/(1+Γ).
- Simulated float32 reduction-order check.

README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok (90 projects).
